title: MarsTerrainDataV1
description: Proposed v1 payload for one Layer -1 map built from real Mars elevation. Mirrors parseMarsTerrainData in src/terrain-kit/marsTerrainContract.ts. Two cross-field rules cannot be expressed in JSON Schema and must be checked in code: elevation.columns == grid.columns + 1 and elevation.rows == grid.rows + 1; len(elevation.samplesMeters) == elevation.columns * elevation.rows. See docs/mars_terrain_contract.md sections 7 and 8.

latitude.description: Planetocentric latitude of the map centre, degrees, positive north. Polar maps are not supported in v1.

longitudeEast.description: East-positive longitude of the map centre, degrees.

cellSizeMeters.description: Ground size of one cell, metres.

samplesMeters.description: Metres above datum, row-major from the north-west corner. Length must equal columns * rows (checked in code). NoData (null) is not allowed in v1.

datum.description: Identifier of the vertical reference. Value still to be agreed (open decision 1).

resolutionMeters.description: Ground resolution of the source dataset, metres (not the grid cell size).

productId.description: Optional. Omit the field rather than sending null.

seed.description: Owned by the backend. Unsigned 32-bit integer.
